span.label: mechanisms
span.term: GABA is taken back up more efficiently in the ICCN of GEPR-9s, so less GABA remains in the synapse to reach postsynaptic GABA receptors, inhibition is weakened, and seizures start in that nucleus despite the extra GABAergic neurons.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Alternatively, excitation is enhanced in the ICCN through overexpression of glutamate receptors, which would fit the raised glutamate and aspartate levels measured there.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Seizure activity initiated in the ICCN is carried out of the colliculus along the bilateral ICCN-to-external-nucleus projection and onward to the superior colliculus and pontine reticular formation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How the surplus of small GABAergic neurons produces the observed pharmacological defects at GABAergic synapses is unresolved.
span.note: what this limits: the causal link between the cell-count finding and the pharmacology: IT REMAINS TO BE RESOLVED HOW THE INCREASE IN SMALL GABAergic NEURONS IN THE ICCN IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE KNOWN PHARMACOLOGICAL DEFECTS OBSERVED AT GABAergic SYNAPSES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The contribution of other brainstem structures to seizure propagation has not been established.
span.note: what this limits: the seizure-propagation account: FURTHER STUDIES ARE REQUIRED TO DETERMINE THE RELATIONSHIP OF THESE OTHER STRUCTURES TO THE PROPAGATION OF SEIZURE ACTIVITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two candidate mechanisms offered for seizure initiation remain untested.
span.note: what this limits: the initiation mechanism: TWO HYPOTHESES WILL BE TESTED IN FUTURE STUDIES: (1) INCREASED GABA UPTAKE, AND (2) INCREASED GLUTAMATE RECEPTOR EXPRESSION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Epilepsy-prone GEPR-9 rats have far more GAD-positive (GABAergic) neurons in the inferior colliculus than non-seizing Sprague-Dawley rats, with the excess concentrated where the central nucleus is largest.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The same increase was obtained by two independent anatomical techniques, GAD immunocytochemistry and GAD67 mRNA in situ hybridization.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Nissl counts show the total neuron number in the ICCN is also raised in GEPR-9s, so the extra GABAergic cells are additional neurons and not existing neurons that switched to a GABAergic phenotype.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Across GEPR-9s, Sprague-Dawley rats and their crossed offspring, the number of small neurons in the ICCN rises together with the audiogenic response score.
span.note: WHOSE RESULT THIS IS: ns in the ICCN and the audiogenic response score (Ribak et al. 1988b). - 2026-08-26 terminal-a. THE RESULT OR THE NUMBER IS THE CITED WORK'S. Q-1119.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Moderately seizing GEPR-3 rats have significantly more small ICCN neurons than Sprague-Dawley rats, and the count matches the value the correlation line predicted in advance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Knife cuts placed between the central and external nuclei of the IC block audiogenic seizures, as do lesions of the ICCN itself or of the lateral lemniscus.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The ICCN-to-external-nucleus projection is the route by which seizure activity leaves its site of initiation in the ICCN and propagates.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The number of axosomatic synapses per soma in the ICCN is the same in GEPR-9s and Sprague-Dawley rats, which rules out the idea that the extra GABAergic neurons act by adding inhibitory contacts onto cell bodies.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Seizure-prone offspring outnumber seizure-resistant offspring in GEPR-9 x Sprague-Dawley crosses by more than three to one, indicating that audiogenic-seizure susceptibility is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Electron microscopy indicates that four of the six major cell types of the central nucleus of the inferior colliculus are GABAergic inhibitory neurons.
